note: Fourth review of 1.24.12 (Start wins over Stop, above all the one-line seal-in, in Structured Text and Arduino), by an agent that had not seen the rule written nor the earlier reviews. 175 programs of its own: 92 right (expect silent), 83 wrong (expect flag; fix is its own corrected line, checked by truth table over every input and the old output state). On the build it reviewed: 16 of the 92 right ones spoken about (sensors not named as such: a pressure switch, a photo eye, a thermostat; a hand-made edge whose memory is set in an if; a start bit cleared after a ')'; a Stop handled in a helper function defined above or below; a later if that runs the machine from a request bit and stops it on Stop; a permissive that holds the Stop; a machine output named Clamp or TripperConveyor taken for a lamp or a trip), 55 of 83 found, and 1 line wrong (NOT (Stop OR Reset) moved out whole, so Reset won over Start too). Run 2026-11-09. Replayed by tests/review_1252.js.
